title: S2Dialog: Multimodal Dialogue Retrieval with Semantic and Acoustic-Style Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.14029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal dialogue retrieval aims to retrieve dialogues from multimodal dialogue banks that are similar to a target dialogue in terms of both textual semantics and acoustic conversational styles. Such dialogue-level retrieval is crucial for many dialogue-related tasks, including Emotion Recognition in Conversation, Spoken Dialogue Systems, and Conversational Speech Synthesis, where external dialogue examples can provide valuable semantic and stylistic references. However, existing retrieval methods are still largely limited to utterance-level or unimodal matching, and often fail to capture the global semantic coherence and stylistic consistency of an entire dialogue. To address this gap, we propose S2Dialog, a unified framework for dialogue-level semantic-style retrieval from multimodal dialogue banks. translated_title: S2Dialog：基于语义与声学风格建模的多模态对话检索
translated_abstract: 多模态对话检索旨在从多模态对话库中检索与目标对话在文本语义和声学对话风格上相似的对话。这种对话级检索对于许多对话相关任务至关重要，包括对话情感识别、口语对话系统和对话语音合成，在这些任务中，外部对话示例可以提供有价值的语义和风格参考。然而，现有检索方法在很大程度上仍局限于话语级或单模态匹配，往往无法捕捉整个对话的全局语义连贯性和风格一致性。为解决这一差距，我们提出了S2Dialog，一个用于从多模态对话库进行对话级语义-风格检索的统一框架。具体来说，S2Dialog由对话级文本检索器和对话级声学检索器组成，它们对文本进行编码。
tldr: S2Dialog提出了一个统一框架，通过对话级文本和声学检索器，首次实现了对多模态对话库中对话级语义和风格的一致检索，解决了现有方法在全局语义和风格匹配上的不足。
en_tdlr: S2Dialog proposes a unified framework with dialogue-level textual and acoustic retrievers, achieving consistent retrieval of semantic and stylistic features in multimodal dialogue banks for the first time, addressing the limitations of existing methods in global semantic and style matching.
